items.definition:
domination
The team's domination of the league was clear.

flora
The island is known for its unique flora and fauna.

functionality
The new software offers improved functionality.

gamma
Gamma rays are a form of electromagnetic radiation.

genome
Scientists are working to map the human genome.

a formal accusation
The grand jury issued an indictment against the suspect.

the period of specialized medical training; legal right to live somewhere
After medical school, she began her residency in pediatrics.

the act of encouraging something to develop or become more active
The brain needs constant stimulation to stay active.

the state of being exposed to the possibility of being attacked or harmed
His emotional vulnerability made him relatable.

extreme anger
The king's wrath was feared throughout the land.

loyalty or commitment of a subordinate to a superior or of an individual to a group or cause
Citizens pledge allegiance to their country.

a body of voters in a specified area who elect a representative
Each constituency elects one Member of Parliament.

a group of people united by some common feature
A large contingent of fans traveled to the away game.

the whole of something
He read the book in its entirety.

a mass departure of people
There was a mass exodus from the city before the storm.

the adverse side effects or results of a situation
The political fallout from the scandal was significant.

a part of a city, especially a slum area, occupied by a minority group
The term 'ghetto' originally referred to Jewish quarters in European cities.

the aspect of someone's character that is presented to or perceived by others
He adopted a confident persona for his public appearances.

the attitude or practice of accepting a situation as it is and being prepared to deal with it accordingly
His paintings are known for their stark realism.

the sun (especially in astronomy)
The Martian rover has been active for many sols.

a group of companies or organizations
A consortium of universities is funding the research.

the ability to produce a desired or intended result
The efficacy of the new drug is still being studied.

the action of obtaining or procuring something
The company is responsible for the procurement of raw materials.

the action of suppressing something
The government ordered the suppression of the protest.

the body of terms used with a particular technical application in a subject of study, theory, profession, etc.
Understanding the correct terminology is crucial in legal studies.

the action of checking or proving the validity or accuracy of something
The experiment provided validation for the new theory.

punishment inflicted or retribution exacted for an injury or wrong
He swore to take vengeance on those who had wronged him.

the state of understanding something clearly
The philosopher sought spiritual enlightenment.

a body of troops stationed in a particular place
The garrison defended the fort.

The state of not supporting or helping either side in a conflict.
Switzerland is famous for its neutrality in international conflicts.

The climax of sexual excitement.
The book discussed the physiology of an orgasm.

A gland surrounding the neck of the bladder in male mammals.
Regular check-ups are important for prostate health.

a bag-like part of an animal or plant
The spider laid its eggs in a silk sac.

an edge or border
The country was on the verge of civil war.

a digital ledger
Blockchain technology is used for cryptocurrencies like Bitcoin.

a person's death; the end or failure of something
The company's demise was caused by poor management.

a follower or student of a teacher, leader, or philosophy
He was a devoted disciple of the philosopher.

control or sovereignty
The country gained dominion over its former colonies.

unacceptable or improper behavior
The employee was fired for serious misconduct.

the act of making the best or most effective use of a situation or resource
We are working on the optimization of our production process.

sexually explicit material
The debate about the legality of pornography continues.

The study of human societies and cultures.
She decided to major in anthropology at university.

Something that is based on another source; a financial contract whose value is derived from an underlying asset.
The new song was a derivative of an older folk tune.

a tiller or wheel and any associated equipment for steering a ship or boat; a position of control
The captain took the helm as the storm approached.

the practice of claiming to have moral standards or beliefs to which one's own behavior does not conform
His speech was full of hypocrisy, given his past actions.

the establishment or starting point of an institution or activity
The project has been successful since its inception.

one's family and relations
She invited all her kin to the family reunion.

a person who makes laws; a member of a legislature
The new bill was proposed by a senior legislator.

a public declaration of policy and aims, especially one issued before an election by a political party or candidate
The party published its manifesto before the election.

a connection or series of connections linking two or more things
There is a strong nexus between poverty and crime.

a twisting force that tends to cause rotation
The engine produces high torque at low RPMs.

a collection of written or spoken texts
Linguists often use a large corpus of text for their research.

all the people in a country or area who are entitled to vote
The government is trying to win over the undecided electorate.

foreign exchange (market)
Many people trade in the forex market.

a large molecule made of repeating units
Plastic is a common type of polymer.

a crack, split, or break in friendly relations
A rift developed between the two friends.

a substance or surface on which an organism lives or a process occurs
The enzyme acts on a specific substrate.

the state of being superior to all others
The team fought for supremacy in the league.

an official pardon for people who have been convicted of political offenses
The government granted amnesty to political prisoners.

a companion or fellow member of an organization
He addressed his fellow comrades at the meeting.

the act of moving something from its usual place
The war caused the displacement of thousands of people.

conformity to the law or to rules; the ability to be defended with logic or justification
The government's legitimacy was questioned after the scandal.

a seemingly absurd or self-contradictory statement or proposition that may in fact be true or well-founded
It's a paradox that standing still can make you feel tired.

a very strong wind
A strong gale swept across the coast.
